minutes.headline: Board heard Comcast cable license talks, Lancaster water plans, and a newly paved road fee; backed a truck traffic study.
minutes.summary: The Select Board heard a cable committee update on stalled Comcast license talks, the water district on the Lancaster expansion and permit limits, and the DPW director's proposed fees for cutting newly paved roads. It also planned the October workshop and economic development steps, backed a truck traffic study, and took the town manager's report with building and space-needs updates.

what_happened.line: The Select Board heard that Comcast cable license talks are stalled over the share of revenue and the size of a capital grant.
The DPW director proposed fees for cutting newly paved roads; the director and town manager, with counsel, will draft a fee schedule and check neighboring towns.
The water district briefed the board on the Lancaster expansion and permit limits; the board will check whether a letter of support for the grant can still be filed.
A motion to send a letter of support for a regional truck traffic study was made; the minutes do not capture the result.
The board kept the October 10th boards and committees workshop and set an economic development workshop for November 14th.

why_it_matters: A new cable license would set what subscribers pay each month in fees, and a new road-cut fee schedule would add costs for utilities and contractors that dig into newly paved streets.
Turkey Hill roof and renovation costs, and the water district's expansion and permit limits, bear on future capital requests and on water service.
watch_next: October 3rd: the board meets to discuss a solar pilot agreement, and the Planning Board is to be sent a memo.
October 10th: the boards and committees workshop and the postponed executive session.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the main items: the charter review ratification, the warrants, the cable figures, the executive session move, and the main grant and cost figures. Our minutes could not hear the outcome of two votes that the official minutes record as passed, and there are differences in the Turkey Hill percentage, the Lancaster letter, and some names.
